title: Lemon Coconut Cake
description: A simple old-school favourite — bright lemon, soft crumb, and that warm coconut finish.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grease and line a 28 cm round cake tin.
In a saucepan over medium heat, combine milk and butter. Stir until the butter is melted. Remove from heat.
Add sifted flour and sugar to the milk mixture. Stir gently until the sugar dissolves.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing between additions. Add lemon juice, lemon zest, and desiccated coconut. Stir until just combined — do not overmix.
Pour the mixture into the prepared tin and smooth the surface.
Bake for 35–40 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Cool completely on a wire rack before icing.
For the icing: sift icing sugar into a bowl. Add lemon juice slowly, mixing until a thick, spreadable paste forms.
Spread icing over the cooled cake.
Sprinkle with lemon zest and desiccated coconut to decorate.

notes.title: Gentle Mixing
notes.content: Stir only until just combined after adding the eggs and coconut. Overmixing develops gluten and makes the cake tough rather than tender.

notes.title: Icing Consistency
notes.content: Add lemon juice a little at a time — the icing should be thick enough to spread but not runny. If it becomes too thin, add more sifted icing sugar.
